note: Frame spans retain the established phrase-grid timing. Current-user lyrics are active narrative input; the Island Memory Tapestry remains the locked visual canon.

entries.visual_action: Aged linen awakens as faded nautical-map ink draws itself into the fibers.
entries.animation_behavior: Internal ink emergence and canvas-fiber micro-motion first; restrained slow dolly out only after map geometry stabilizes.
entries.lyric_cue: Miraba el mar desde el fuerte / pensando en ti, mi querida.
music_cues: First vocal phrase establishes fort and remembrance
entries.transition: Fluid material continuation into embroidery; no hard cut.

entries.visual_action: Bright embroidery blooms and threads through the established antique map.
entries.animation_behavior: Thread growth, tension and tiny textile sway inside a locked composition; camera remains static.
entries.lyric_cue: El viento trae tu nombre / entre las olas dormidas.
entries.transition: Candidate FX2-TRANS-021 chroma_pigment_transport into ocean-current color.

entries.visual_action: Map ink and embroidery liquefy into deep blue-green ocean currents while the tactile canvas remains visible.
entries.animation_behavior: Pigment and thread flow laterally like currents; preserve textile surface identity; add only a graceful bounded pan.
entries.lyric_cue: Lejos de España nacimos / bajo este cielo tan claro.
music_cues: Measured pulse continues without abrupt energy change
entries.transition: Candidate FX2-TRANS-032 structural_morph_transition from ocean mass into village forms.

entries.visual_action: Thick ocean paint gathers upward into a rustic island village.
entries.animation_behavior: Impasto rises from water/pigment into architecture; internal gathering precedes a restrained dolly in.
entries.lyric_cue: Si el destino nos separa / el corazón sigue amando.
music_cues: Closing phrase of the opening lyric block
Gentle cadence before the expanded verse
entries.transition: Candidate FX2-TRANS-032 structural_morph_transition preserving shared geography into fort walls.

entries.visual_action: Village geometry hardens and weathers into historical fort walls without breaking spatial continuity.
entries.animation_behavior: Bounded architectural morph with a slow orbit; no unplanned axis shift, horizon drift or new structures.
entries.lyric_cue: Lejos de la Isla nacimos los dos / bajo este cielo abierto.
entries.transition: Candidate FX2-TRANS-021 pigment transport softens fort surfaces into remembered landscape.

entries.visual_action: Fort pigment softens into luminous color and reforms as an abstract imagined homeland.
entries.animation_behavior: Stone dissolves into color wash, landscape breathes subtly, and the camera tilts upward only after the transformation is readable.
entries.lyric_cue: Crecimos donde el viento salado toca los montes / donde gritan las aves del puerto.
entries.transition: Candidate FX2-TRANS-024 fog_pigment_travel introduces atmospheric veil.

entries.visual_action: Painted smoke, translucent cloud and watercolor veils cross and partially obscure the homeland.
entries.animation_behavior: Atmosphere provides the motion while the composition remains fixed; smoke/cloud layers travel independently of the locked homeland.
entries.lyric_cue: Aprendí tu rostro a la luz del farol / tu voz bajo la lluvia de verano.
music_cues: Pulse stays stable beneath a more reflective phrase
entries.transition: Candidate FX2-TRANS-025 ghosted_memory_transition into anonymous human presence.

entries.visual_action: Dark featureless silhouettes emerge, fade and re-form inside mist, cloud and water.
entries.animation_behavior: Mist drifts independently while silhouettes phase in and out; slow bounded pan; never reveal facial features or fixed identities.
entries.lyric_cue: Y cada camino que me llevó lejos / terminó trayéndome de regreso.
entries.transition: Candidate FX2-TRANS-025 ghosted_memory_transition gathers all motifs into the complete tapestry.

entries.visual_action: Accelerating pullback reveals the complete tapestry in a dark void; its four corners fold inward toward the center.
entries.animation_behavior: Controlled pullback and symmetric inward folding; preserve all previously established motifs inside one readable tapestry.
protected_regions: all prior motifs inside one tapestry
entries.lyric_cue: Y aunque cambien las mareas / aunque los caminos nos lleven lejos / tu voz sigue viva entre estas piedras / como una llama que no muere.
music_cues: Scale broadens while the visual world is unified
entries.transition: Candidate FX2-TRANS-032 structural_morph_transition compresses tapestry into one thread.

entries.visual_action: The collapsed tapestry becomes a single luminous textile thread suspended in darkness.
entries.animation_behavior: Static framing; internal color travels beneath the fibers with restrained light vibration and no shape drift.
entries.lyric_cue: Que ruja el mar oscuro a medianoche / que soplen los vientos desde lejos.
music_cues: Chorus remains at high emotional intensity
Visual energy compresses rather than expands
entries.transition: Bounded thread-motion handoff into the final swept-away shot.

entries.visual_action: An unseen force catches the thread; it bends, stretches and is swept away until it vanishes into pure black.
entries.animation_behavior: One fluid follow movement with bounded thread deformation; thread becomes smaller and fainter without spawning new forms; end on full black.
entries.lyric_cue: Si el destino nos separa, mi amor / el corazón no sabe soltarte.
music_cues: Final lyric phrase resolves the separation motif
entries.transition: End on pure black; no postscript image.
